    (f : X → Y) (hf : IsContinuousLinearMap R f) :
    ContDiff R ⊤ f := by

    have h : f = (fun x =>L[R] f x) := by rfl
    rw[h]
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.isBoundedLinearMap
  apply IsBoundedLinearMap.contDiff hf
